title: Lovely Crispy Greek Chickpeas Revithia
description: A sweet and crispy Greek dish featuring chickpeas, cider vinegar, and ferment-jang, with anti-inflammatory properties, formed into revithia
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together cider vinegar, ferment-jang, olive oil, honey, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika
Add the chickpeas to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and spread the chickpeas out in a single layer
Bake the chickpeas for 30 minutes, shaking the pan halfway through
Increase the oven temperature to 425 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes, or until crispy
Remove the chickpeas from the oven and let cool completely
Form the cooled chickpeas into revithia shapes and serve
